title: Add RAG agent tool-calling templates, quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Ava Johnson
description: Adds opinionated RAG agent templates and tool-calling example quickstarts aimed at helping engineers bootstrap retrieval-augmented agents quickly. Motivation: reduce time-to-first-success for customers experimenting with agents + external tools and to provide canonical templates for templates + tool manifests. Changes include 1) a set of YAML RAG template definitions (retriever+prompt+policy) for common patterns (FAQ bot, docs assistant, ticket triage), 2) Python and TypeScript agent examples demonstrating tool-calling (HTTP fetcher, calendar lookup, internal search API) with SDK usage patterns and error handling, 3) docs site quickstarts and step-by-step guides including configuration notes for Dedicated/Private deployments, 4) sample test prompts and an eval harness configuration used by CI to catch regressions. Checklist: [x] add YAML templates and examples [x] update docs site quickstarts and sidebars [x] add unit and smoke tests for examples [x] include migration notes for older templates [ ] add more TypeScript tool wrappers (follow-up). Related: ENG-4321 tracks canonical template formats; SUP-1287 captures a customer ask for calendar tool integration. This PR aims to be non-breaking and purely additive.

Liam Chen: Docs site build flagged an HTML validator warning for the code block in docs-assistant.md. Author reply: fixed code block fence and ensured proper escaping; re-ran docs build locally.

Mateo Garcia: Can we add an example of using a Dedicated model variant with lower-latency profile? Author reply: added a note in quickstarts about pinning model_version and suggested config for dedicated capacity; left deeper Dedicated examples for a follow-up PR.
